release_name: Live TV v4.3.0 — Ultimate Sports & Cinematic Broadcast Suite (Ambilight, Sports HUD, Voice Remote & EPG)
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🏆 Feature-Packed Floating Sports Scoreboard HUD: Draggable, collapsible frosted glass mini-widget with multi-sport filtering (Cricket, Football, Tennis, Motorsport), dynamic Win Probability Gauge bars, expandable live ball-by-ball commentary drawer, and 1-click 'Watch Live' tuning
📌 Sticky Match Pinned Pill: Pin any live match to a persistent floating screen pill that remains visible across channels and full-screen playback with live score updates
💡 Dynamic Ambient Backlighting (Ambilight Mode): Real-time hardware-accelerated edge sampling engine casting rich responsive reactive ambient lighting around player borders
✂️ Instant 15s Highlight Clip Creator: One-click highlight recorder automatically cutting, packaging, and downloading stream action moments directly to your Downloads folder
🎛️ Dual Audio Mixer (Stadium Ambient + Custom Commentary): Independently blend and balance primary stadium crowd noise with custom auxiliary commentary feeds (50/50, 80/20, 20/80 presets)
🔊 Smart Dynamic Range Audio Normalizer & Night Mode: Integrated Web Audio DynamicsCompressor automatically suppressing loud ad explosions while boosting soft whispers and quiet commentary
💬 Real-Time Live Speech-to-Text Closed Captions: Real-time speech recognition generating floating subtitle captions for news and sports lacking native subtitle tracks
📅 XMLTV Electronic Program Guide (EPG Timeline Grid): Visual 12-hour program schedule timeline across all stations with real-time show progress and one-click tuning
📡 Google Cast, AirPlay & DLNA Smart TV Transmitter: Instant casting to Apple TV, Google TV, Samsung, and LG Smart TVs, plus local network DLNA streaming links
🎙️ Voice Remote Assistant: Hands-free voice recognition on Mac and Phone Remote for rapid channel tuning, muting, sports scores, and playback control
⚡ Seamless Stream Health Sniffer & Auto-Failover: Automatic background stall detection recovering dropped connections or switching to mirrors without manual viewer intervention
📑 Channel Bouquets & Lineup Remapper: Custom channel numbering and customizable thematic bouquet categories (e.g., 'IPL 2026', 'FIFA World Cup')
⏰ Morning TV Wake-Up Alarm: Automated scheduled TV alarm with customizable gentle volume fade-in ramp
